mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel_transaction(payment_no,order_no,amount_cents,currency,status,channel_transaction_no) VALUES(#{channelCommand.paymentNo},#{channelCommand.orderNo},#{channelCommand.amountCents},#{channelCommand.currency},'PENDING',#{channelTransactionNo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payment_no=payment_no
mapper.select: SELECT payment_no,order_no,amount_cents,currency,status,channel_transaction_no,channel_version,updated_at,succeeded_at FROM channel_transaction WHERE payment_no=#{paymentNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE channel_transaction SET status=#{status},channel_version=channel_version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),succeeded_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='SUCCEEDED' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE succeeded_at END WHERE payment_no=#{paymentNo} AND status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fault_scenario(payment_no,mode,actor_id,reason) VALUES(#{paymentNo},'SUCCESS','SYSTEM','首次支付绑定默认场景') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payment_no=payment_no
mapper.select: SELECT payment_no,mode FROM fault_scenario WHERE payment_no=#{paymentNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO process_task(task_no,payment_no,next_retry_at) VALUES(#{taskNo},#{paymentNo},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)+INTERVAL 5 SECOND) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE task_no=task_no
INSERT INTO callback_task(task_no,payment_no,payload,deliveries_required) VALUES(#{taskNo},#{paymentNo},#{payload},#{deliveriesRequired}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE task_no=task_no
